name: quick-mental-reset
description: Quick Mental Reset — Live Word Challenge. Real-time multiplayer Wordle for live presentations.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
